Title: The Old Man and the Sea
FullTitle: The Old Man and the Sea
SortTitle: Old Man and the Sea, The
Plot: Santiago is an aging, down-on-his-luck, Cuban fisherman who, after catching nothing for nearly 3 months, hooks a huge Marlin and struggles to land it far out in the Gulf Stream.
Tagline: SPENCER TRACY in his most suspenseful role...ERNEST HEMINGWAY'S story of Heroism...Defeat...Victory!
